title: eat shit & die 236
author: bpatrick
body: It seems fitting that I feel like the primary audience for whom Onan is made. There is even a panel here that looks like it comes from a comic I would enjoy reading.

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.text: so good to get more Onan, thanks

comments.author: Kevin
comments.text:
The panel with the splattered brains? Thinking of becoming a neurosurgeon?

Great comic.

Do robots have feelings?

comments.author: Thomas
comments.text: I just wanted to say that I love your work.

comments.author: kw
comments.text: ooooooooooooooh snap!! had always assumed that all the Onan strips were fragmented bits with no direct timeline.. but the question here remains; which onan will be featured in the next??

comments.author: practik
comments.text: Panel 3’s a nice one too – the overlapping helmets and hair seemed so right when I was still thinking they were two versions of the same person. Which just adds to the paranoia now that I know they’re not.

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.text: Thanks everyone! It’s actually panel 14. It looks like it could be from a “real” comic to me.

comments.author: ego
comments.text:
this comic is precisely, 100% the opposite of “Questionable Content”.

thank you.
